text:
Two goats gnaw a knotted, hard, dry branch in the willow, for in green spring it was sweet, soft, tender, and delicious to them.

They find the taste strange and bitter, no good branch along the bank, for as its season passed, so did its delightful taste.

Missing that flavor, they bite from branch to branch and stubbornly remain unfed.

Memories of my sweet good days, so I wander after you, seeing nothing but ended joys!

translation.title: Two Goats Are Gnawing a Knotted Branch
